svg.title: Keep a chain of custody
svg.desc: Illustrated interlocking chain links connect four stages: original data and permitted use, approved processing, copies that remain, and retention or deletion. At each stage, document the location, responsible person or service, and permitted access. Branches identify sensitive content in conversations, outputs and logs, and backups. Record how long each copy is kept, who arranges removal, and what is retained, removed, or awaiting action. The chain represents documented custody and responsibility.
svg.text: Location · responsible person or service · access
How long is each copy kept?
The record follows every copy, including backups
